[[Team Galactic HQ]] }} '''Besting Buizel I''' (Japanese: '''VS ブイゼルI''' ''VS Buizel I''), titled '''VS Buizel I''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 401st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 64th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Capture and Pupil''' (Japanese: '''捕獲と弟子入り''' ''Capture and Apprenticeship'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Capturing and Apprenticeship''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Pearl}} wakes up in a panic, unsure of where he is. He is relieved to find his Pokémon in their [[Poké Ball]]s beside him, but quickly remembers that they had been injured when he failed to protect {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf}} from [[Team Galactic]]. He apologizes to the three of them, then moves to a nearby window to realize that he is somewhere in [[Pastoria City]]. The sound of singing fills the air, and Pearl follows the noise to find [[Crasher Wake]], sweeping the floor while listening to his own theme song. Realizing that Wake had rescued him and brought him to the [[Pastoria Gym]], Pearl thanks him profusely. Wake tells him that he was simply performing his job as a [[Gym Leader]], then explains that [[Rad Rickshaw]] is fixing his bicycle in the Gym's storage room. Pearl follows Crasher Wake outside, where his {{p|Quagsire}} and {{p|Floatzel}} are still using {{m|Rain Dance}} to refill [[Lake Valor]] with water. Wake notes that Floatzel's speed would make it a great Pokémon for Pearl's team. When Pearl asks Wake if he is going to give Floatzel to him, he declines. Instead, he gives Pearl advice on how to catch one himself. Crasher Wake steers Pearl to {{rt|213|Sinnoh}}, where there are many Floatzel and {{p|Buizel}}. He gives him a few empty Poké Balls, and Pearl immediately shifts his attention to sending his Pokémon after some Floatzel. Wake advises Pearl to instead go after a Buizel and [[Evolution|evolve]] it. After weakening one with [[Rayler]], Pearl throws a Poké Ball at it. To his surprise, the Poké Ball bounces off of its head. The Buizel glares at him and begins to growl. Wake points out that all of the [[wild Pokémon]] on Route 213 have been made angry due to the force of the Galactic Bomb drying up their habitats. He explains that the Pokémon know that humans are responsible for the damage done to their lairs, and Pearl feels immense guilt for being unable to stop the explosion. Seeing Pearl's change in mood, Crasher Wake brings him to a [[face board]] of a {{p|Croagunk}}. He puts Pearl's face through the hole in the board, encouraging him to see things from a new perspective. Pearl's Pokémon laugh when they see him, causing Pearl to laugh too. Wake explains to him that it's good to laugh when things don't go as planned. Pearl agrees, and realizes that because he has been separated from {{adv|Diamond}} for so long, he had forgotten that. Wake offers to train Pearl in order to prepare him to fight Team Galactic, and Pearl eagerly accepts. Meanwhile, at the [[Team Galactic HQ|Galactic Veilstone Building]], [[Cyrus]] explains to [[Charon]] that the airships are heading toward [[Veilstone City]]. He tells him that their next step is to build the [[Red Chain]] by using the powers of {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Uxie}}, {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit}}, and Azelf. ==Major events== * {{adv|Pearl}} begins his training with [[Crasher Wake]] and sets out to capture a {{p|Buizel}} or {{p|Floatzel}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Pearl}} * [[Crasher Wake]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Charon]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Luxray}} ([[Rayler]]/{{tt|Rayhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Floatzel}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s) * {{p|Azelf}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf|Adventures}}; flashback) * {{p|Buizel}} (later {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Buizel}} (multiple) * {{p|Floatzel}} (multiple) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 泳氣鼬I|VS Buizel I}} (Taiwan)
